answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 57694 Country: MM Title: Dream Interpreataion Question: A few months ago, I saw a dream in which about 3 or 4 people were carrying me. I got wounds on my body but I didn't feel any pain. And I was reciting Kalimah Shahadah. I will be looking forward to your reply. Answer ID: 57694 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 351/351/N=04/1436) In the time of fitnah, each Muslim needs to make his or her faith firm so that one is steadfast on faith with maturity and full insight in the time of calamity and infliction. And this can be achieved by adapting one’s life completely to Islam i.e. life becomes compliant to Shariah and Sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
